messages:
Ben (PM): quick milestone tickler — can each owner post: 1) what shipped this quarter 2) what slipped (and why) 3) next steps + ETA + any blockers? Please @ people as needed. Goal: rollup by EOD Fri :calendar:

Sam W.: Shipped: runtime v2 latency improvements (canary finished). Slipped: autoscaler policy docs & rollout checklist — blocked by flaky infra tests. Next: root-cause + PR #452, ETA Tue.

Jia L.: Console: shipped base per-route charts and alerting. Slipped: per-route cost breakdown (backend contract not finalized). Next: finalize contract with infra, will post contract diff today. ETA Wed.

Oliver K.: Saw the contract draft. I'll add comments in rfc/metrics-api.md. Can take API work next sprint but need one clarifying field on billing mapping.

Maya P.: ML infra: shipped quantization profile for redwood-small, +12% token throughput. Slipped: eval regression on prompt-set B (rare halluc). Next: re-run evals with v2 kernels and prepare rollback plan. Asking @Sam W. for validation window. ETA Thu.

Sam W.: acknowledged. I'll carve out a 30m sync Thu 11am PT to decide rollback vs patch.

Ben (PM): thanks — quick callouts: any cross-team deps preventing ship today? Tag owners and blockers now.

Jia L.: Dep: metrics API (owner: Oliver). Dep: billing mapping for cost breakdown (owner: Aisha F.). If billing isn't mapped, we can't enable cost dashboards for customers.

Aisha F.: noted, finance will review mapping today. If there are semantic gaps I'll flag by EOD.

Oliver K.: prioritizing metrics API comments this afternoon. One ask: can Jia post a sample event payload? that'll speed impl.

Jia L.: posting sample payload in thread in 10m.

Ben (PM): perfect. Action items I'll capture in the rollup doc: - Sam: schedule Thurs sync (11am PT) - Jia: post payload & update contract (ETA Wed) - Oliver: implement API changes (follow rfc thread) - Maya: finish eval rerun + rollback plan (ETA Thu) - Aisha: confirm billing mapping (EOD)

Ben (PM): if anything slides further, ping here or DM me. I'll compile the rollup and send to execs tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
